gifts: Adjustable training cone set with agility ladder

recommendation.rationale: These gifts let Oliver practice his favorite sport at home, improve coordination, and keep play fresh and social. The ball and pop‑up goal give immediate game action, while the cones and drill board add fun skill challenges that grow with him.

wish.text: Dear Oliver, at 11 you’re already a brilliant soccer star, and I’ve placed a shimmering new ball and a pop‑up goal in the North‑Pole workshop just for your games. May the magic of training cones that twirl and a clever drill board bring you endless fun on the field. Merry Christmas!
